reviews.text:
We took our dog for grooming, specifying that he is phobic; he's not aggressive at all, but he's fearful. At the end of the grooming, we were told in general terms that our dog is a complicated dog because he would occasionally get very agitated. The price for the service was higher than average. After three days, two large scabs appeared, and the vet told us they were two burns from drying out. We were very sorry for the dog; we're treating him with antibiotics and ointment.

While the grooming wasn't easy at times (but we warned him that the dog was fearful) and that we all make mistakes, we wanted to be informed of what happened and not find out later.
Extremely kind and attentive, after several horrendous experiences, I've found a place for my dogs, who go out peacefully and beautifully. I've been coming back for a while now and I'm very happy.
Processional and kind. It's not cheap, but there are many more expensive ones in Milan. Trippata, bath, nails 65

Very late, but I really wanted to leave a super positive review! I took my one-year-old cocker spaniel for a stripping and they returned her perfect: clean, tidy, and meticulously cared for. I'll be back in two weeks. Thank you so much again!

I'm so happy to have brought my Lagotto Lillo back after more than a year. In addition to his professionalism, you can see Stefano's great love for his work...which is not a given! Thank you! The photo is of Lillo just "backcombed" 😂 …
They're really good and knowledgeable. I brought my little Corgi and they treated him like a king, professionally. I'll definitely be back!
My flying donkey is like new😍(JOKING) …

A dog was returned without warning that he had injured one of his paws during clipping. We noticed this at home after calling for an explanation and an apology. He said it was our fault for the knots. Speechless, terrible professionalism and poor manners. All that was needed was to report the injury when the dog was returned and apologize.

I took my 5-year-old miniature schnauzer, Jack, and was very satisfied. They're one of the few who know how to give this breed the right cut. They were also very punctual and fast, which helped Jack avoid too much stress, as he's very anxious when it comes to going to the groomer. I'll be back soon and will also take advantage of the self-service wash.

We are extremely satisfied with the high level of professionalism in the grooming services. Stefano immediately gained the trust of Ghita (Akita Inu) and myself, who happily entrusts herself to his care every time, in the large and comfortable shower room.

They're professionals. They know how to handle dogs of any breed and size. My dog ​​doesn't like baths, and finding someone who can do the job is hard. They do it brilliantly here. I've never trusted them more.

I've been taking my 1-year-old Samoyed, Chapo, and my mother's 13-year-old Scottish Shepherd, Gughli, for a while now.
What can I say...fantastic, professional, and above all empathetic (with their owners, but especially with their furry friends).
There's nothing better than trusting someone to leave your dog with such peace of mind!

Terrible!
I took my cocker spaniel for the first time, and they gave her back a mess, still wet, her tail unkempt and unbrushed, her paws still dirty and uneven. I tried to ask for explanations, but in response they made a lot of unrealistic excuses, blaming my cocker spaniel, who had never in her life misbehaved with other handlers, who had always complimented me on her behavior.
Super nice staff, my poodle's cut is impeccable.

For the first time, and certainly the LAST, I brought my poodle. His hair was uneven, with "gaps" (very short, with other spots left long), not to mention the hair on his ears! The groomer was completely incompetent for the poodle breed.
The icing on the cake: an additional cost for nail trimming (it wasn't specified in advance).

Bloody scabs for 2 weeks.

Let me start by saying that we're talking about an extremely cooperative poodle …
Tommaso is a competent and knowledgeable groomer, I had a great experience! My poodle has never been so cute. Highly recommended.

This is a job that only passion can enhance and motivate. Here, Ashley has found the solution to all her grooming needs.
You can trust her with your eyes closed.
